prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: static background photograph for a realistic home saltwater aquarium.
Primary request: Generate one original genuinely photorealistic 16:9 image, 2048x1152 pixels, showing the entire front of a modest 90cm-wide rimless rectangular glass saltwater aquarium on a low dark walnut cabinet in a quiet domestic living room.
Composition/framing: Straight front-on camera, level and centered. The aquarium occupies x=8%-92% and y=12%-85% of the image. The rectangular glass bottom and both side edges must be clearly visible, with subtle glass reflections close to the edges. A horizontal waterline is 17% down the image. A dim warm domestic room is only very slightly visible around the tank. One small LED fixture above the aquarium; a small discreet filter outflow at the upper right inside the tank.
Scene/backdrop: Dark slate-blue rear glass with shallow, finite aquarium depth. Low sculptural porous live rocks occupy the bottom third, arranged as two small groups with generous open swimming space between and above them. Fine creamy sand floor at y=77%-82%. Small colorful natural soft corals and anemones in pink, green, orange, and lavender sit on the low rocks.
Lighting/mood: Calm soft white/cyan illumination from the LED, clean clear water and clean clear glass, realistic detailed rock, sand and coral textures, believable household scale.
Constraints: This is a real compact home aquarium, not a public aquarium. Nothing huge; no tall dominant coral. No fish and no moving animals in the background. No people, text, logos, UI, checkerboards, or watermark.
Avoid: Open ocean, ocean horizon, deep sea, cinematic sunbeams or light rays, haze, murky water, enormous reef structures, toy-like or illustrated materials.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: transparent PNG sprite atlas of small household saltwater aquarium fish.
Primary request: Generate one original 2048x2048 square image with genuine RGBA transparency, an exact 3x3 atlas of nine equal square cells. The cell boundaries are invisible. One distinct photorealistic fish per cell, nine fish total, absolutely no duplicates.
Composition/framing: Each fish is centered in its cell, about 75% of the cell width, with clear transparent margins around the full body and all fins and tail. All nine fish face RIGHT in neutral swimming side profile. Each specimen is separate and entirely contained within its own cell.
Exact cell order, left to right and top to bottom:
Top row: 1. orange-and-white clownfish; 2. Banggai cardinalfish with long fine fin extensions; 3. royal gramma with purple front and yellow tail.
Middle row: 4. red/orange firefish goby with a tall dorsal fin; 5. striped six-line wrasse; 6. pale yellow watchman goby with speckles.
Bottom row: 7. blue-green chromis; 8. patterned green/orange mandarin dragonet; 9. mottled tan lawnmower blenny.
Style/medium: Genuinely photorealistic small aquarium specimens, realistic natural muted-to-bright colors, very fine scales, anatomically plausible delicate translucent fins and tails. Clean photographic cutouts appropriate for compositing into a domestic saltwater tank.
Constraints: Genuine transparent alpha background and margins, no opaque background, no simulated transparency checkerboard, no shadows below the fish, no glow, no cell dividers, no grid lines, no text, no numbers, no labels, no logo or watermark. No plastic or toy appearance. No extra fish. Whole fins and tails must remain within each own cell.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: transparent PNG sprite atlas of small household saltwater aquarium invertebrates.
Primary request: Generate one original 2048x2048 square image with genuine RGBA transparency, an exact 2x2 atlas of four equal square cells. The cell boundaries are invisible. One small photoreal creature per cell, centered with generous transparent margins; every antenna, leg, arm, and shell must fit fully inside its own cell. Exactly four creatures, no other creatures.
Exact cell order:
Top left: One red-and-white scarlet cleaner shrimp, side profile facing RIGHT, with long fine white antennae.
Top right: One small cerith snail, side profile crawling to the RIGHT, with a spiral conical shell and small antennae.
Bottom left: One red-legged hermit crab carrying a small ridged shell, side-front view facing RIGHT.
Bottom right: One small orange five-armed reef starfish in a natural horizontal substrate-resting pose, viewed slightly obliquely from the front and above, not vertically upright. Render only the starfish, no substrate.
Style/medium: Genuinely photorealistic natural small aquarium animals, detailed shell ridges and surface texture, fine delicate appendages, credible anatomy and proportions, calm clean photographic cutouts.
Constraints: Genuine transparent alpha background and generous clear margins. No substrate, background, drop shadows, simulated checkerboard, words, numbers, labels, grid, cell borders, logos or watermark. No extra creatures and no duplicate animals.
